title: Revit Parameter Implementation
purpose: Implement S8-governed parameter structures in Revit using the central Shared Parameter Registry as authority, with stable GUID identity and controlled instance/type/category application.
preconditions: The applicable S8 parameter requirements are known.
The central Shared Parameter Registry is available for governed shared-parameter identities.
Any required parameter bindings/categories for the project scope are defined or explicitly unresolved.

steps.name: Resolve parameter identity from the governed source
actions: Before creating or binding a shared parameter, resolve its GUID, name, data type, status, and applicable scope from the central registry.
Do not use copied project TXT files or locally created parameters as authority.
validation: Each governed shared parameter resolves to one central registry identity.
No conflicting GUID/name pair is introduced.

steps.name: Apply the correct Revit parameter behavior
actions: Use instance or type behavior according to the applicable governed requirement/registry entry.
Bind the parameter only to the required categories/scope.
Place project information parameters in the appropriate Revit information context where governed.
validation: Parameter behavior and binding match the governing requirement.
No broader local binding is introduced without an approved reason.

steps.name: Control new or project-local parameters
actions: Do not create a new governed shared parameter without the applicable approval/registry process.
Treat source tables explicitly marked EXAMPLE ONLY as scaffolds rather than approved parameter sets.
Where a visitor/project-local parameter is permitted, mark and manage it according to S8 governance rather than silently promoting it to citizen status.
validation: New governed parameter identities have a traceable approval/registry record.
Visitors/local parameters are distinguishable from governed citizens.

steps.name: Verify deployed parameters against the registry
actions: Compare deployed parameter GUIDs, names, and data definitions against the central registry.
Record missing, conflicting, deprecated, and unresolved identities for remediation.
validation: Applicable governed parameters match the central registry.
Conflicts and unresolved source rows do not silently pass compliance.

outputs: Revit parameter deployment aligned with S8 governance and the central Shared Parameter Registry
future_dependencies: Resolution of source rows whose GUID remains unavailable
Complete governed binding/category data where required
governance_notes: The central registry is authoritative for governed shared-parameter identity; TXT/project copies are derived carriers or observations.
Discipline-specific parameter sets shown as examples in source are not promoted unless separately governed.

provenance.migration_note: Normalized beneath canonical S8 parameter governance. Source example parameter sets are retained only as noncanonical scaffolding.
